# vercel skills

Discover agent skills relevant to your project

```
vercel skills [query] [options]
```

## Options

- `--format <FORMAT>` — Specify output format (json)
- `--json` — Output results as JSON
- `-y, --yes` — Accept default value for all prompts

## Examples

Recommend skills based on detected project

```
$ vercel skills
```

Search for skills by keyword

```
$ vercel skills nextjs
```

Global options (`--cwd`, `--scope`, `--token`, `--debug`, ...) also apply; see `global-options.md`.
